# `storage/LegacyOperatorMigration.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/LegacyOperatorMigration.js`

One-time ownership migration for data written before OperatorContext existed. A bounded subset of the pre-operator presentation state belonged to the only local user. Once there is exactly one verified Realm Passport and no rejected profile record, this service stages, verifies, and compare-and-swap promotes validated desktop shortcuts, Start pins, app settings, and window geometry into that Passport's operator namespace before account-owned subsystems bind. Authority-bearing state is intentionally excluded. Legacy sessions, grants, credentials, AppSandbox databases, and unsigned social state remain in their original quarantine and are never made authoritative by this migration. If an earlier V1 receipt exists, V3 inventories the account destination instead of trusting the retained source or the receipt's bounded summaries. It keeps only revalidated presentation files, moves every other exact-hash copy into internal quarantine, and blocks activation while any ambiguous file remains.
